Regarding AI Usage

We’d like to be transparent about our use of generative AI in Demonologist.

Generative AI was only used to create some in-game pictures, posters, paintings, achievement icons, and Steam store capsule artwork.

No AI is used for any other purpose in the game. Everything else is made by humans.

We’ve also updated our Steam AI disclosure accordingly. Clock Wizard Games ❤️

items.title: Demonologist: Halloween Update Is Here!
items.summary: Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over
items.content:
Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists

A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over 110 new sequences, new achievements, gameplay improvements, performance optimizations, and much more.

The dead are calling again. Are you ready to answer?

New Content

New Map

Darkwood Junction has been added to the game.

A new location awaits those brave enough to investigate.

With over 110 new sequences to Darkwood Junction, your investigations will bring new paranormal events and unexpected encounters.

Darkness hides more than meets the eye, and not everything waiting for you in Darkwood Junction wants to be found.

Some places should remain forgotten.

New Safe House

Temple has been added as a new safe house.

A new place to prepare for your investigations awaits. Gather your courage, get ready, and take a moment before stepping back into the unknown.

New Cursed Item

Sin Coin has been added to the game.

Not every coin brings fortune. Some tempt fate, while others make you question whether the price was worth paying.

Would you risk it?

Tutorial Map

A new tutorial map has been added to help players learn the fundamentals of their investigations before facing the paranormal.

Whether you're a new investigator or simply need a refresher, this is the place to begin.

Halloween Decorations

Halloween decorations have been added to cursed locations, bringing a seasonal atmosphere to your investigations.

Even the most haunted places are celebrating Halloween. Whether you should celebrate with them is another question.

Halloween Outfits Return

Previously released Halloween outfits are back for a limited time!

Your old favorites have returned, but not for long. Make the most of this opportunity before they disappear again.

Gameplay & Systems

Communicating with the Dead Returns

You asked for it, and it's back!

The ability to communicate with your deceased friends has returned with a new twist. You can now speak with your dead friends through the Spirit Box.

Death doesn't have to be the end of the conversation.

Camera Improvements

  • Fixed an issue that caused cameras to display distorted images.

    [/*]

  • Additional improvements have been made to camera performance and reliability.

    [/*]

Field of View Fixes

  • Fixed issues related to the Field of View (FOV) that could occur when players died.

    [/*]

Performance & Optimization

Performance Improvements

  • Various optimization improvements have been implemented to improve overall performance.

    [/*]

Visual Improvements

Graphics & Lighting Fixes

  • Fixed various environmental issues.

    [/*]

  • Fixed various graphical issues.

    [/*]

  • Resolved lighting issues across the game.

    [/*]

Achievements

3 new achievements have been added to the game.

New challenges await those willing to push their investigations further.

The investigation continues...

The forests are waiting. The dead are calling again. And this Halloween, some old faces have returned.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

Clock Wizard Games

items.title: 5 Video Games Like Phasmophobia
items.summary: "Phasmophobia" has you and your friends locked in terror until all the horrors are conquered. Need more like it? These five games creep close to the goal.
items.content:
Kinetic Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Among the scariest games released within the past several years is "Phasmophobia," developed by the British studio Kinetic Games. The game is available to play solo or online cooperatively, with players controlling a team of ghost hunters. Each level has players investigate a haunted site to determine what kind of spirit is prowling the area. The game ended up getting fixed because it had too many scares as a testament to its overall fear factor.

The surprise success of "Phasmophobia" led to many team-based ghost-hunting games filling the market, several of which are quite good. These games each feature their own memorably haunted sites and unique ghosts to keep players on their toes. With that particular niche in mind, we're listing games that place players in the midst of the haunting as they try to determine what spectral activity they've found themselves up against. Here are five video games like "Phasmophobia," all picked to help keep the paranormal frights coming after you in the dark.

LostOneTeam This game is technically still within its early access phase, but worth checking out: the 2022 title "Ghost Exile" by LostOneTeam. It has teams of up to four players working together to examine sites with suspected hauntings in desperate need of an exorcism. Like "Phasmophobia" and many other games on this list, players use environmental clues to determine what kind of phantasm they're facing. Using their equipment, the players then perform an exorcism, though there are lethally dire consequences if they misidentify the apparitions.

"Ghost Exile" brings the spectral terror and crime scene investigation elements to the forefront of its gameplay, but with its own twists. The game offers more customization options for players to make the experience feel truly their own, right down to character design. Like "Phasmophobia," the game also possesses a voice recognition mechanic, allowing players to communicate with ghosts during their examination.

With ghosts that can level up and an unlockable skill tree, "Ghost Exile" brings a surprising amount of depth to its familiar premise. On Reddit , a fan enthusiastically shared their love of the game, writing "Dude, get Ghost Exile. Not only is it scarier than Phasmophobia, it has a ton more to it as far as gameplay and they are actively updating the game all the time. I cannot overstate how much I love that game."

Clock Wizard Games The 2023 game "Demonologist" dials up the sheer terror and supernatural menace compared to many of the other titles on this list. The game again has players either work alone or with teams of up to four to investigate paranormal locations. After identifying the types of apparitions that present around a given site, players can then work together to exorcise the lethal entities; familiar, but it works. The ghosts feel much more dangerous than they do in "Phasmophobia" as they will lash out and stalk players investigating them.

"Demonologist" is definitely one of those horror games that you should play during the spooky season . This is a game that heavily evokes a pervasively unsettling atmosphere and ramps up the suspense as the various spirits go on the offensive. To elevate the scares, the game features incredibly detailed environments and an immersive sound design, really putting players on edge. As Redditor u/DonkeyShaunJr put it, "The level of detail of the hidden items, the lore, it really helped us keep engaged with the game."

An even more intense take on a familiar premise, "Demonologist" is best played with friends, rather than taking on these hellish frights alone.

Dreambyte Games The 2024 game "Forewarned" has more of a grave robbing premise rather than one revolving around paranormal investigations. The game has teams of up to four players raid ancient Egyptian tombs for treasure, only to incur supernatural wrath at each burial site. The investigative elements that are present in the gameplay are used to identify the types of undead monsters prowling the sites. With this knowledge, players can exploit the mummies' strengths and weaknesses as they recover holy relics and escape in one piece.

With a cultural focus on Egyptian legends and some slightly silly stereotypes, "Forewarned" certainly stands out from other supernatural investigation games out on the market. The game's tomb raiding premise also helps differentiate it, while providing players with an alternative objective to other games on this list. A fan on Reddit described it as being "like Phas with mummies and randomly generated maps. Its awesome."

Like "Phasmophobia," the game also enjoys virtual reality headset functionality, making it a particularly terrifying game to play in VR . A team-based game that does something much more distinct with the usual premise, "Forewarned" is a lot of fun when coordinating with friends over the immersive device.

Renderise After initially launching in an early access phase on Steam in 2022, "Ghost Watchers" got its official release in 2025. Like every other game on this list, the title allows up to four players working together to battle ghosts. Players explore haunted locations like abandoned houses, police stations, and ghost towns to determine what kind of paranormal activity is afoot. From there, gamers have a whole arsenal of tools to help them fight back against the deadly enemies and end their threat for good.

With dozens of unique enemy types and an immersive variety of environments to explore and purge of phantasms, "Ghost Watchers" reflects its years of hard work from the developers. Renderise has crafted a genuinely spooky experience that, like all the other games on this list, is best experienced in the company of friends. Because many of the enemies in this game are truly terrifying, purging them is all the more satisfying. A moody little ghost hunt, "Ghost Watchers" is the most recent title on this list and one well worth checking out. As Steam reviewer Skyblade799 put it, "Of all of the ghost-identification games ... this actually might be my favorite."

Hitchcock Games Another terrifyingly fun twist on these familiar ghost-hunting genre tropes is the 2019 game "Pacify." Developed by Shawn Hitchcock and published by Hitchcock Games, the game has teams of up to four players investigating haunted sites featuring various apparitions, including one of a young girl. Players must avoid provoking the direct wrath of these supernatural entities and figure out how to pacify these paranormal threats long enough to escape. In addition to single-player and co-op modes, the game also has a PvP mode that pits the players against each other in an office setting.

items.title: Warlock as a Demonologist: A Look at the Diablo 4 x WoW Collaboration
items.summary: On Saturday, May 2, the third collaboration cosmetic set between Diablo 4 and World of Warcraft (WoW) was released.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on On Saturday, May 2, the third collaboration cosmetic set between Diablo 4 and World of Warcraft (WoW) was released. This collaboration has garnered significant attention, as it is packed with homages to early WoW expansions, from the original game through Wrath of the Lich King.

These Warcraft collaboration cosmetics are based on the iconic Tier armor sets that players wore back in the original game. Along with these, legendary weapons that players once wielded in-game—such as Ashbringer, Sulfuras, Shadowmourne, and Thori'dal—have also been recreated. Let’s take a look at how these Warcraft collaboration items appear in-game.

Taste the flames! Molten Core Tier sets in Diablo 4

The newly released Warcraft Collection pack consists of class-specific armor cosmetics designed based on WoW's Tier 2 sets.

Tier sets were class-specific gear sets dropped as rewards from top-tier raids each season. They were developed not just for their stats, but for their distinct and attractive designs tailored to each class. With every new raid release, the design of the new Tier set always draws significant interest.

The Tier 2 sets were the gear dropped in the early raid, Molten Core. They enjoyed long-lasting popularity due to their iconic designs that perfectly captured the class fantasy. They are so symbolic that they were even remastered with modern modeling to celebrate WoW's 20th anniversary in 2024.

The class associations between Diablo 4 and WoW in this collaboration are also quite interesting. The Barbarian received the Warrior's Tier set, while the Sorcerer was paired with the Mage, which shares a similar concept. The Necromancer received the Death Knight's armor (added for the 20th anniversary), and the Spiritborn was given the Shaman's gear, as both classes manipulate nature's spirits. The Druid, Rogue, and Paladin were reborn as their WoW counterparts, and the Spiritborn (Warlock) donned the set of the Warlock, sharing the same English name.

A mount you couldn't get in Azeroth, now rideable in Sanctuary

Along with class-specific cosmetics, individual WoW-themed items have also been released. You can find mounts based on iconic bosses from early expansions like Anzu and Sindragosa, as well as pets like the mini-Ragnaros and 'Murk-li-el,' a Murloc dressed as Tyrael.

Additionally, a set of gear related to Illidan Stormrage, the final boss of The Burning Crusade, has been introduced. It includes back ornaments recreating Illidan's wings, the Bulwark of Azzinoth (famous as a 'front-facing shield'), Warglaive of Azzinoth, Zhar'doom, Greatstaff of the Devourer, and finally, the Skull of Gul'dan that Illidan carried.

You can also find the Ashbringer in the Reliquary

A Warcraft-themed Reliquary has also been introduced. You can purchase the items within the Reliquary using currency earned naturally through gameplay. Some items can be purchased solely with in-game currency without any additional cost, allowing you to acquire Warcraft collaboration items without spending real money.

Paid items consist of iconic WoW weapons like Ashbringer, Sulfuras, Thunderfury, and Atiesh, as well as flashy Town Portal effects. Also, note that if you purchase all items in the Reliquary, you can obtain the Soulflayer Hakkar pet, based on the boss famous for the Corrupted Blood incident.
